# AI Reset Tracker

> Unofficial multi-provider usage-limit reset tracker for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Grok / xAI.
> Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, or xAI.

Generated: 2026-09-10T18:35:00Z

## Machine-readable data

- [/data/summary.json](/data/summary.json): per-provider counts, mean gap, longest drought, days since last
- [/data/resets.json](/data/resets.json): full event catalog with provider, kind, delivery, reason_tags, scope, date (UTC), url, account, note
- [/rss.xml](/rss.xml): announcement RSS feed
- [/llms.txt](/llms.txt): this file

## Event schema

Each event has:
- provider: claude | codex | grok
- kind: reset | policy
- delivery: immediate | banked | unknown
- reason_tags: string[] (includes competitive_response for rival-aligned timing)
- scope: string
- date: ISO-8601 UTC
- url: original announcement or docs
- account: announcing handle
- note: short paraphrase

## Anticipator (score formula)

Score 0–100 from additive features (capped):
1. Drought vs mean gap (0 / 10 / 22 / 35) — or thin-history drought bump when mean is unknown
2. Rival pressure (0 / 12 / 16 / 22) — if another provider had product_launch / milestone / competitive_response / banked reset in the last 3–7 days
3. Weekend proximity (+12 Fri–Sun UTC)
4. Recent reason patterns (+4 to +8)
5. Pace dampener (−8) for high-frequency providers early in cycle

Labels: low <18, moderate <35, elevated <55, high ≥55. Descriptive only — not a schedule.

## Definitions

- reset: Announcement that flushed usage counters (5-hour and/or weekly).
- policy: Announcement that changed limits without flushing counters; listed but not counted as a reset.
- immediate: Reset applied (or propagating) without requiring the user to redeem a banked credit.
- banked: Credit placed in a reset bank for the user to apply later.
- unknown: Delivery mode unclear from the announcement text.
- competitive_response: Reset timing aligned with a rival lab launch/promo — retention-pressure interpretation.
